node.statement: For j notin G_a, the definition G_a={j:dist_1(p_j,C)>a*tau} gives d_j<=a*tau, hence by the support-functional branch t_j=H-phi(p_j)>=H-a*tau. Because P_vj^+>=0 and t_j>=0, (H-a*tau)*sum_{j notin G_a} P_vj^+ <= sum_{j notin G_a} P_vj^+*t_j <= sum_j P_vj^+*t_j <= nu_v*(2+4*delta). The hypothesis H>a*tau makes H-a*tau positive, so division gives sum_{j notin G_a} P_vj^+ <= nu_v*(2+4*delta)/(H-a*tau).
